font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 5-fold stratified cross-validation with one shared seed. FERL uses the compact, medium and deep presets of fuzzy_greedy_tree; the GA uses a stated search budget.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: The association rule defaults were chosen on 20 of these datasets; baselines use library defaults. Dots are the mean (accuracy) or median (rules, time) across datasets.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: The band through each dot spans the interquartile range across datasets, not a confidence interval.
